title: Turing-profile-v1.0 void receipt
description: One VOID attempt of EXP-001: an infrastructure failure BEFORE any sealed score exists (no verdict). All void receipts of the sealed experiment share one numbered sequence in one directory, <eval root>/<C_f>/run/bundle/void_receipt_<n>.json (eval root ~/aien-data/turing-cal/eval), n = first free number, exclusive create, never overwritten. Three writers use it: generate_sealed_data.sh (stage generation), record_void.sh for a failed frozen-tree test at BLINDING_PROTOCOL.md step 7 (stage tests), and turing-cal-eval run (stage evaluation). The receipt with n = 3 also writes final_receipt.json (terminal_receipt schema, kind inconclusive_infra, verdict INCONCLUSIVE, reason INFRA), which ends EXP-001. A retry of a stage must repeat that stage's first void attempt byte for byte (command and inputs). A dry run writes void receipts in its own --out and never ends anything. Refusal codes: calibration/docs/EVALUATOR.md section 3; rule: calibration/docs/FAILURE_REPORTING.md section 2.
